_comment: Floors for the nightly benchmark. Measured on 2026-10-04 with the protocol in docs/evaluation.md: IsolationForest ROC AUC 0.616, event recall 0.92, average precision 0.232 on NAB realAWSCloudwatch. The floors sit a little below those numbers so an unrelated fluctuation does not page anyone, but a real regression - a feature change that quietly destroys the signal - fails the job. Update the numbers only when the change is deliberate, and say why in the commit.
